name: Can finish carpenters replace existing interior doors and frames?

mainEntity.name: Can finish carpenters replace existing interior doors and frames?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, installing new interior doors and casing is a core part of finish carpentry. Whether you are replacing dated hollow-core doors with solid-core slabs or installing entirely new pre-hung door units, finish carpenters square the jambs, shim them plumb, and install matching casing. Proper installation ensures doors latch smoothly without rubbing the frame or floor. If existing rough openings are out of plumb due to older house settling, our team adjusts the framing and drywall edges to ensure a clean, trouble-free fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Finish carpenters install pre-hung doors or slab replacements, shim jambs plumb, adjust latch alignment, and finish the opening with matching trim casing.
